zh.title: Offer 比较与谈判：价格之外要看什么
zh.seo_title: Offer 比较与谈判：卖方指南｜陈靖
zh.description: 最高价的 Offer 不一定最好。本文说明如何逐项比较价格、融资、Contingency、时间和买方经纪报酬请求，以及还价和多个 Offer 时要注意的问题。
zh.lead: 收到 Offer 后，先把数字和条款放进同一张表，再谈判。最后能否顺利成交，往往取决于价格以外的条款。

en.title: Comparing Offers and Negotiating as a Seller
en.seo_title: How to Compare Offers and Negotiate | Jing Chen
en.description: The highest offer is not always the strongest. Compare price, financing, contingencies, timing and buyer-agent requests, then decide how to counter.
en.lead: When offers arrive, put the numbers and terms in one table before negotiating. Whether a deal closes often depends on more than the price.
